title: aegilops squarrosa subvar. truncata
intro: Aegilops squarrosa subvar. truncata, commonly known as spelt, is a type of ancient grain that belongs to the wheat family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, which can be attributed to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of spelt include its potential to lower cholesterol levels and improve blood sugar control. Spelt contains bioactive constituents such as avenanthramides, phenolic acids, and selenium, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
